name: Axelrod culture: cultural drift (Klemm et al.)
description: Klemm, Eguíluz, Toral and San Miguel 2003: cultural drift (per event, a random trait on a random feature) on the 12 × 12, 15-trait lattice; metric: distinct cultures after 20 000 ticks. Small drift lets the lattice keep reorganizing until one culture dominates; heavy drift keeps it disordered. Measured (release, seeds 1–5, recorded 2026-09-25): 26.2 with no drift (stable), 18.8 at 10⁻⁵, 4.8 at 10⁻⁴, 5.0 at 10⁻³ and 55.4 at 10⁻² — the paper's multicultural outcome survives only without noise or with a lot of it.
